name: What are the energy-saving benefits of spray foam insulation?

mainEntity.name: What are the energy-saving benefits of spray foam insulation?

acceptedAnswer.text: Spray foam insulation creates a superior air seal compared to other insulation types, dramatically reducing air leakage and drafts. This air barrier helps to prevent conditioned air (heated or cooled) from escaping your home and unconditioned air from entering. The result is a more stable indoor temperature, reducing the workload on your HVAC system. Homeowners often experience a noticeable decrease in their energy bills due to lower heating and cooling demands, especially in climates like Orange County where temperature control is key.
acceptedAnswer.description: Spray foam significantly reduces air leakage, leading to more stable indoor temperatures, lower HVAC workload, and reduced energy bills.
